up: Retrieve all activity records with exact measured values (standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null) and the corresponding compound structures (canonical SMILES) for the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649968. Output the assay ChEMBL ID, compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for each activity.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649968' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
